meta.title: Session memory manager
meta.description: Web-only session memory manager: configures idle reclaim for sessions with no viewers and no pending messages; it does not own session content or modify logs.

session-memory-controller.idleDescription: Choose how long an idle session stays in memory.
session-memory-controller.refused: Save was refused; configuration was not changed.
session-memory-controller.stale: The configuration changed; select a value again before saving.
